jobs.prompt: Use case: game sprite. A SINGLE connected young story-tree crown pose on a transparent fixed 192 by 176 canvas. Low-isometric whimsical hand-crafted pixel art in moss, forest green, warm lime and muted ochre matching the supplied palette. Place a small dense asymmetrical leafy sprout in the lower middle. Its attachment point is exact bottom-center at pixel 96,160. Build a deliberate fully opaque foliage overlap collar around that attachment point: a connected dark moss-green U-shaped leaf mass spanning about x 78 to 114 and y 142 to 169, with no transparent hole through the middle. The collar is part of the crown and must wrap behind/around a trunk top so the trunk-to-canopy seam is hidden. Above it, a modest irregular budding crown, roughly x 64 to 128 and y 82 to 160. FOLIAGE ONLY. No trunk, no branches, no roots, no island, no ground, no shadow, no detached clusters, no floating leaves, no halo, no text, no border. Keep generous transparent padding and keep the bottom-center collar opaque.
jobs.observedResult: PixFlux returned a whole-tree/island study despite the foliage-only constraint. The upper connected palette-matched crown was retained at author/import time; generated land and wood were excluded. Owner LOOK later rejected the prompted low ellipse, so y141 and below is excluded from every source frame before the replacement join is authored.
